## Overview

Fieldnote is a quiet log for hobbyist birders: record what you saw, where and when, then get out of the way. The design language follows from that promise. It is calm, plain and legible, closer to a well-kept field notebook than to a social app. There is no feed to decorate and nothing competing for attention, so the system spends its restraint on two things: one green that always means "do this", and type that stays readable on a phone in flat morning light.

The landing page opens on a faint **dawn-horizon wash**, a soft horizontal blend of `{colors.wash-dawn}`, `{colors.wash-sage}` and `{colors.wash-mist}` across the top third of the hero. It evokes the hour most birders are out without using photography. Below it the page returns to `{colors.canvas}` white, with feature bands on `{colors.canvas-soft}` and one warm interlude on `{colors.canvas-paper}`, the colour of a notebook page.

The colour system has two working roles. **Field green** (`{colors.primary}`, `#2F6B4F`) is the fixed brand colour and the only CTA colour, used once per band. **Deep ink** (`{colors.ink}`) is a green-black used for all body text, never pure black, so text and accent feel like one palette. `{colors.surface-deep}` carries the featured pricing tier.

Typography is **Inter**. Display sizes run at weight 300 with negative tracking for an unhurried, editorial voice; body and UI sizes run at 400 so they hold up outdoors. Every count and timestamp uses tabular figures.

**Key Characteristics:**
- A faint dawn-horizon wash behind the landing hero; app surfaces stay plain white.
- One filled green pill per band. Green is never decoration.
- Thin (300) display type with negative tracking; regular (400) body for field legibility.
- Tabular figures (`tnum`) on every count, date and time, so a list scans in columns.
- Pill buttons sized for a thumb: 44px minimum height.
- A notebook-paper band (`{colors.canvas-paper}`) as the one warm interlude.
- A dense but airy sightings table: hairline rows, no zebra striping, no cell borders.

## Colors

### Brand & Accent
- **Field Green** (`{colors.primary}`, `#2F6B4F`): The brand colour, fixed. Filled CTA pills, inline links, focus rings, the selected state in filters. White text on it measures **6.29:1** (passes AA for all text sizes).
- **Green Hover** (`{colors.primary-hover}`, `#285b43`): Hover state, and the text colour on `{colors.primary-subdued}` tags. White on it: 7.87:1.
- **Green Press** (`{colors.primary-press}`, `#1c3f2e`): Pressed state. White on it: 11.67:1.
- **Green Soft** (`{colors.primary-soft}`, `#347758`): A lighter step for chart marks and icon accents in the app. White on it: 5.35:1, so it can still carry a label.
- **Green Subdued** (`{colors.primary-subdued}`, `#cce6da`): Pale fill for soft tags such as "Lifer". `{colors.primary-hover}` text on it: 5.96:1. Never carries white text (1.32:1).
- **Deep Surface** (`{colors.surface-deep}`, `#173528`): The featured pricing tier and any inverted block. White on it: 13.32:1.

The hover, press, soft and subdued steps keep the lightness ratios of the source system's accent ladder (hover ≈ 0.85×, press ≈ 0.59×, soft ≈ 1.12× the base lightness) at the brand green's own hue and saturation.

### Wash
- **Dawn** (`{colors.wash-dawn}`, `#f3e3c8`), **Sage** (`{colors.wash-sage}`, `#d6e6da`), **Mist** (`{colors.wash-mist}`, `#e4ecee`): The three stops of the hero wash. Low-saturation, so `{colors.ink}` text sits on any part of it at well above 4.5:1. Not used for buttons, text or borders.

### Surface
- **Canvas** (`{colors.canvas}`, `#ffffff`): Default page and app background.
- **Canvas Soft** (`{colors.canvas-soft}`, `#f6f8f5`): Faintly green-tinted off-white for feature bands and the app's filter bar.
- **Canvas Paper** (`{colors.canvas-paper}`, `#f4efe4`): Warm notebook-paper band. `{colors.primary}` on it: 5.49:1.
- **Hairline** (`{colors.hairline}`, `#e2e8e3`): 1px card borders and table row dividers.
- **Hairline Input** (`{colors.hairline-input}`, `#a9bfb2`): Form-field borders, a step darker so fields are findable outdoors.

### Text
- **Ink** (`{colors.ink}`, `#14261d`): Default text. 15.85:1 on white.
- **Ink Secondary** (`{colors.ink-secondary}`, `#2b3d33`): Secondary text. 11.55:1 on white.
- **Ink Mute** (`{colors.ink-mute}`, `#5f6e66`): Captions, table headers, helper text. 5.37:1 on white, 5.03:1 on `{colors.canvas-soft}`, 4.69:1 on `{colors.canvas-paper}`. Do not go lighter than this.
- **On Primary** (`{colors.on-primary}`, `#ffffff`): Text on green and deep surfaces.

### Semantic
Not defined yet. See Known Gaps.

## Typography

### Font Family

**Inter** (open source, Google Fonts) for everything, loaded at weights 300, 400 and 500. Set `font-feature-settings: "cv11"` on the body for Inter's single-storey `a`, which softens the texture of running text. Add `"tnum"` on numeric content. Fall back to `system-ui`.

### Hierarchy

| Token | Size | Weight | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{typography.display-xxl}` | 56px | 300 | 1.03 | -1.4px | Landing hero headline |
| `{typography.display-xl}` | 48px | 300 | 1.15 | -0.96px | Section opener |
| `{typography.display-lg}` | 32px | 300 | 1.1 | -0.64px | App page title ("Sightings") |
| `{typography.display-md}` | 26px | 300 | 1.12 | -0.26px | Price, compact card title |
| `{typography.heading-lg}` | 22px | 400 | 1.1 | -0.22px | Pricing tier name |
| `{typography.heading-md}` | 20px | 400 | 1.4 | -0.2px | Feature card title |
| `{typography.heading-sm}` | 18px | 400 | 1.4 | 0 | Empty-state title |
| `{typography.body-lg}` | 16px | 400 | 1.5 | 0 | Marketing body, form inputs |
| `{typography.body-md}` | 15px | 400 | 1.45 | 0 | Default UI body |
| `{typography.body-tabular}` | 14px | 400 | 1.4 | -0.28px | Sightings table cells (`tnum`) |
| `{typography.button-md}` | 16px | 500 | 1.0 | 0 | Pill button label |
| `{typography.button-sm}` | 14px | 500 | 1.0 | 0 | Compact pill label |
| `{typography.caption}` | 13px | 400 | 1.4 | -0.26px | Table caption, timestamps (`tnum`) |
| `{typography.micro}` | 12px | 400 | 1.4 | 0 | Fine print, footer legal |
| `{typography.micro-cap}` | 11px | 500 | 1.15 | 0.4px | All-caps eyebrow, tag label |

### Principles
- **Thin is for display only.** Weight 300 at 26px and up gives the landing page its calm. Below that, 300 goes grey and spindly in sunlight, so everything from `{typography.heading-lg}` down is 400 or 500.
- **Negative tracking scales with size.** -1.4px at 56px down to -0.2px at 20px; zero at body sizes.
- **Tabular figures for the list.** Counts, dates and times in the sightings table and life list use `tnum`, so "2" and "14" line up and a week's list reads like a ruled column.
- **Inputs are 16px.** `{typography.body-lg}` on every field, which also stops iOS zooming the page on focus.

## Layout

### Spacing System
- **Base unit:** 8px, with 2 / 4 / 12 for fine work.
- **Tokens:** `{spacing.xxs}` 2px · `{spacing.xs}` 4px · `{spacing.sm}` 8px · `{spacing.md}` 12px · `{spacing.lg}` 16px · `{spacing.xl}` 24px · `{spacing.xxl}` 32px · `{spacing.huge}` 64px.
- **Section padding:** 64–96px on the landing page; 16–32px in the app.
- **Card padding:** 32px on feature and pricing cards; 24px on the app preview card.

### Grid & Container
- Landing page centres in a ~1120px container; the hero wash runs edge to edge above it.
- Features run 3-up → 1-up. Pricing has two tiers: 2-up → 1-up.
- The app is a single column: page title, filter bar, table. Max width ~960px on desktop so rows stay scannable.

### Whitespace Philosophy
The landing page breathes: generous section gaps, short paragraphs, nothing above the fold but the headline, one sentence and one button. The app tightens to `{spacing.lg}` gutters because birders tidying the day's list want to see as many rows as possible, but row height never drops below 44px.

## Elevation & Depth

| Level | Treatment | Use |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Flat, 1px `{colors.hairline}` border | Default for cards, tables, inputs |
| 1 | `box-shadow: rgba(23,53,40,0.08) 0 1px 3px` | Card lift on white, sticky filter bar |
| 2 | `box-shadow: rgba(23,53,40,0.08) 0 8px 24px, rgba(23,53,40,0.04) 0 2px 6px` | App preview card on the landing page, menus, popovers |
| 3 | Dawn-horizon wash | The landing hero's atmosphere, colour rather than shadow |

Shadows are tinted with `{colors.shadow-tint}` rather than black so they sit inside the green palette.

### Decorative Depth
The hero wash is the only decoration. Build it as a CSS linear or radial gradient across the three wash stops at low opacity; it should read as morning haze, not as a graphic. The app has no decorative depth at all.

## Shapes

### Border Radius Scale

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `{rounded.xs}` | 4px | Table chrome, nav focus outline |
| `{rounded.sm}` | 6px | Form inputs, selects |
| `{rounded.md}` | 8px | Sightings table container, alerts |
| `{rounded.lg}` | 12px | Feature, pricing and preview cards |
| `{rounded.xl}` | 16px | Bottom sheets on mobile |
| `{rounded.pill}` | 9999px | All buttons, tags |

### Imagery
No photography in the core system. The landing page shows the product itself: a `card-app-preview` with a few real-looking sightings rows. If bird imagery is added later, see Known Gaps.

## Components

### Buttons

**`button-primary-pill`**: the one filled CTA ("Start your list", "Filter", "Go Flock").
- Background `{colors.primary}`, text `{colors.on-primary}`, type `{typography.button-md}`, padding 12px 20px, rounded `{rounded.pill}`. Minimum height 44px.
- Hover `button-primary-pill-hover` → `{colors.primary-hover}`. Pressed `button-primary-pill-pressed` → `{colors.primary-press}`.
- Focus: 2px `{colors.primary}` outline at 2px offset, visible on keyboard focus only.

**`button-secondary`**: outline alternative ("Clear filters", "Get started" on the free tier).
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, text `{colors.primary}`, 1px solid `{colors.primary}` border, same geometry.

**`button-on-dark`**: the CTA inside `card-pricing-featured`.
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, text `{colors.surface-deep}`, same geometry. Inverted so the featured tier still has a single, obvious action.

### Cards & Containers

**`card-feature-light`**: one of the three "Built for the field" features.
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, padding `{spacing.xxl}`, rounded `{rounded.lg}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}` border. Title `{typography.heading-md}`, body `{typography.body-md}` in `{colors.ink-secondary}`.

**`card-pricing`**: the Free tier.
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, padding `{spacing.xxl}`, rounded `{rounded.lg}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}` border. Name `{typography.heading-lg}`, price `{typography.display-md}` with `tnum`, list `{typography.body-md}`, CTA pinned bottom.

**`card-pricing-featured`**: the Flock tier.
- Background `{colors.surface-deep}`, text `{colors.on-primary}`, otherwise identical to `card-pricing`. CTA is `button-on-dark`.

**`card-paper-band`**: the warm interlude, e.g. a short "How it works" or a quote from a birder.
- Background `{colors.canvas-paper}`, text `{colors.ink}`, padding `{spacing.xxl}`, rounded `{rounded.lg}`. At most one per page.

**`card-app-preview`**: a static slice of the sightings table on the landing page.
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, type `{typography.body-tabular}`, padding `{spacing.xl}`, rounded `{rounded.lg}`, Level 2 shadow. Shows three or four rows of real-looking data.

### Data

**`sightings-table`**: the core of the app.
- Container `{colors.canvas}`, rounded `{rounded.md}`, 1px `{colors.hairline}` border. Cell padding `{spacing.md} {spacing.lg}`, row height ≥ 44px.
- Header row: `{typography.micro-cap}` in `{colors.ink-mute}`, uppercase, on `{colors.canvas-soft}`.
- Cells: `{typography.body-tabular}` in `{colors.ink}`. Count column right-aligned. "When" uses `tnum`.
- Rows separated by 1px `{colors.hairline}`; no zebra stripes, no vertical borders.
- Caption ("12 sightings this week"): `{typography.caption}` in `{colors.ink-mute}`, above the table.
- Keep it a real `<table>` with `scope="col"` headers on every breakpoint; the mobile layout restyles rows rather than replacing the markup.

**Empty state**: title `{typography.heading-sm}`, one line of `{typography.body-md}` in `{colors.ink-secondary}`, and a `button-secondary`. No illustration.

### Inputs & Forms

**`text-input`**: species search, and the base for selects.
- Background `{colors.canvas}`, text `{colors.ink}`, type `{typography.body-lg}`, padding 10px 12px, rounded `{rounded.sm}`, 1px `{colors.hairline-input}` border, min height 44px.
- Focus `text-input-focused`: border becomes `{colors.primary}` plus a 2px `{colors.primary-subdued}` ring.
- Labels sit above the field in `{typography.caption}`, `{colors.ink-secondary}`. Placeholder text is a hint, never the label.
- Checkboxes ("Lifers only"): 20px box, checked fill `{colors.primary}`, whole label row is the hit target.

The filter bar sits on `{colors.canvas-soft}`, padding `{spacing.lg}`, and becomes sticky (Level 1) once the table scrolls.

### Navigation

**`nav-bar-on-wash`**: landing-page top nav over the hero wash.
- Transparent over the wash, `{colors.canvas}` once scrolled; text `{colors.ink}`, padding `{spacing.lg} {spacing.xl}`. Wordmark left, Features and Pricing centre, "Open the app" as `button-primary-pill` right.

**App nav**: same bar on `{colors.canvas}` with a 1px `{colors.hairline}` bottom border. The current page (`aria-current="page"`) gets `{colors.primary}` text and a 2px `{colors.primary}` underline.

### Pills, Tags, and Chips

**`pill-tag-soft`**: "Lifer" and similar row tags.
- Background `{colors.primary-subdued}`, text `{colors.primary-hover}`, type `{typography.micro-cap}`, padding 4px 8px, rounded `{rounded.pill}`.

### Signature Components

**Dawn-Horizon Wash**: dawn → sage → mist, blended horizontally across the top third of the landing hero. Quiet enough that a visitor might not consciously notice it.

**Tabular Field Column**: every count, date and time in `tnum`, right-aligned where numeric. The detail that makes the app feel like a notebook.

**`link-on-light`**: inline links in `{colors.primary}`, `{typography.body-md}`, underlined. Unlike a marketing site, an outdoor reader needs more than colour to find a link.

**`footer-light`**: background `{colors.canvas}`, text `{colors.ink-mute}`, type `{typography.caption}`, padding `{spacing.huge} {spacing.xl}`. One or two short link groups and a legal line; Fieldnote doesn't need a mega-footer.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Use `{colors.primary}` for one filled CTA per band, inline links, focus and selected states, and nothing else.
- Keep display tiers at weight 300 with negative tracking, and everything below 22px at 400 or heavier.
- Put `tnum` on every count, date and time.
- Keep every interactive target at least 44×44px; this is a phone-in-the-field product.
- Show the real product on the landing page instead of stock photography.
- Keep the app plain: white canvas, hairlines, no wash.

### Don't
- Don't recolour or tint the brand green. `#2F6B4F` is fixed; derive states from the ladder above.
- Don't put white text on `{colors.primary-subdued}` or any wash stop.
- Don't use `{colors.ink-mute}` on anything darker than `{colors.canvas-paper}`, or go lighter than it for text.
- Don't introduce new accent colours. The wash stops are atmosphere, not a palette for buttons or charts.
- Don't add feeds, badges, counters or notification dots; "quiet by design" is a product promise.
- Don't swap pill buttons for rounded rectangles, or shrink them below 44px tall.
- Don't use zebra striping or cell borders in the sightings table.

## Responsive Behavior

### Breakpoints

| Name | Width | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| Wide | ≥ 1280px | Hero wash edge to edge; content capped at ~1120px |
| Desktop | 1024–1279px | Features 3-up; pricing 2-up |
| Tablet | 768–1023px | Features stack to 1-up; pricing stays 2-up; app table full width |
| Mobile | < 768px | Pricing 1-up; nav collapses to wordmark + "Open the app"; display-xxl drops to 36px; table rows restack |

Mobile is the primary app breakpoint, not the fallback. Design the sightings screen at 375px first.

### Touch Targets
- Every button, link row, checkbox label and table row is at least 44×44px.
- Filter controls stack vertically on mobile with `{spacing.md}` between them; the Filter button spans the full width.

### Collapsing Strategy
- Display tiers stair-step 56 → 48 → 32 → 26px through the breakpoints.
- The hero wash shortens on mobile but stays; it never tiles or repeats.
- **Sightings table on mobile:** each row restacks into a two-line block. Species in `{typography.body-md}` with the count right-aligned on line one; place and time in `{typography.caption}` `{colors.ink-mute}` on line two; the note, if any, below. Column headers are visually hidden but stay in the markup for screen readers.
- The filter bar collapses behind a "Filter" button that opens a `{rounded.xl}` bottom sheet.

### Image Behavior
The `card-app-preview` on the landing page crops to two rows on mobile. No other imagery yet.

## Iteration Guide

1. Change one component at a time, and reference it by name and token (`button-primary-pill`, `{colors.primary}`, `{rounded.pill}`).
2. Add new states as separate component entries (`-hover`, `-pressed`) rather than prose-only variants.
3. Default body to `{typography.body-md}`; use `{typography.body-tabular}` for any table cell and `tnum` for any number.
4. Check contrast for any new colour pairing and record the ratio next to the token in Colors.
5. Design app screens at 375px first, then widen.
6. Keep the landing hero's wash; keep the app free of it.
7. Run `scripts/check-design-md DESIGN.md` after edits; optionally `npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md` for schema validation.

## Known Gaps

- **Dark mode** is not defined. Birders out before dawn would benefit from it; it needs its own surface ladder and a lighter green step that still reads as the brand.
- **Semantic colours** (error, warning, success, offline/sync-pending) are not defined. The app needs at least "sync pending" for offline-first and an error state for failed saves.
- **Logo and wordmark** are not specified; the nav currently uses the product name in text.
- **Iconography** (set, stroke weight, size grid) is not chosen.
- **Bird imagery and illustration**: whether to use photography or species illustration, and how to credit it, is undecided.
- **Charts** for the life list (by year, by place) have no palette beyond `{colors.primary}` and `{colors.primary-soft}`; a multi-series chart would need more.
- **Motion** is not specified. Default to none or minimal, in keeping with "quiet".
- **Data entry**: the three-tap "log a sighting" flow, species autocomplete and location picker have no component specs yet.
